items.stem: When comparing two supplier offers, the most complete basis for the decision is:

options.text: Total cost of ownership across the relationship, not just unit price
options.rationale: Correct: total cost of ownership captures value beyond unit price.
Unit price ignores other costs and risks.

options.text: The supplier with the nicest brochure
options.rationale: Marketing material is not a decision basis.
Response speed alone is not a value measure.

items.explanation: Correct: total cost of ownership captures value beyond unit price.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: A supplier is single-source for a critical part. A sound response is to:

options.text: Develop a risk-mitigation plan such as safety stock or a backup source
options.rationale: Correct: single-source risk needs active mitigation.

options.text: Assume the signed contract removes all risk
options.rationale: A contract does not eliminate supply risk.

options.text: Ignore it unless a disruption happens

options.rationale: Monitoring is part of managing risk.

items.explanation: Correct: single-source risk needs active mitigation.

items.stem: Select TWO elements of a sound strategic sourcing process.

options.text: Analyzing spend and the supply market first
options.rationale: Correct: analysis informs the sourcing strategy.

options.text: Evaluating suppliers against defined, weighted criteria
options.rationale: Correct: weighted criteria support objective selection.

options.text: Choosing a supplier before defining needs

options.rationale: Familiarity is not an objective criterion.

items.explanation: Correct: analysis informs the sourcing strategy. Correct: weighted criteria support objective selection.
